{{Meta Unit}}

== Overview ==
Fused Hero is a {{Rarity|Mythical}} unit. Hе can only be obtained by upgrading [[Carrot (Ultra)]] and [[Vego (Mage II)]] to when they get the fusion skill (upgrade 7 for both) and using the Fusion active skill with [[Carrot (Ultra)]] and [[Vego (Mage II)]]. Takes both of their [[Traits]], but will only take the initial units Level, [[Relics]] and stat alterations (ex. SSS ATK Carrot = SSS ATK Fused Hero).

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

== Trivia ==
*This is the first unit who can achieve three traits or more.
*You cannot place a new Carrot or Vego after forming a unique Fused Hero.
**This effect only happens if Fusion is activated on the unit with unique on it
*Double Unique is possible with {{PAGENAME}} if Carrot and Vego have the Unique trait.
**This makes Quadruple Unique technically possible.

* This units secondary damage type changes depending on the initial unit using the Fusion active, Carrot giving Fused Hero the {{Damage Type|Storm}} Damage Type and Vego giving the {{Damage Type|Light}} Damage Type.

*You only need one of the fusion candidates to be a {{RarityColor|Mythic|Shiny}} to form a {{RarityColor|Mythic|Shiny}} Fused Hero.
